decisions.reason: Naval vessel lighting remains closely tied to the firm's specialist, standards-compliant engineering base, so management is likely to retain it and keep refining it through accumulated market and project learning.
This flagship pendant luminaire is strongly aligned with the firm's strategic direction in advanced interior, efficient and intelligent lighting, making withdrawal within a year very unlikely.

The marine HMI searchlight still draws on the firm's marine and rugged-lighting knowledge, but because HMI technology fits less well with the firm's LED- and sustainability-led development path, it faces a comparatively higher review risk even if kept for now.
